combo1.title: Mediclius: Going-Second 9000 ATK Breaker
combo1.description: Going second into a set-up board. Medius the Pure and Purification Power Patron put Mediclius the Extraordinary Power Patron in the Extra Monster Zone. Only then do you banish the Finite and the Infinite from your hand, so the tripled ATK has a Power Patron Link Monster to apply to. The Division and the Union brings the Finite and the Infinite back under Mediclius, which unlocks its 1+ effect: every face-up monster your opponent controls is negated and at half ATK, and Mediclius can attack up to 3 of them at 9000 ATK. Starting hand: Medius the Pure + Ars Magna the Finite and the Infinite.

cards.name: Ars Magna the Finite and the Infinite
Ars Magna the Division and the Union

steps.text: Normal Summon Medius the Pure.
Activate effect: Medius the Pure was Normal Summoned.
Special Summon Theorealized Medius from your Deck. Theorealized Medius is always treated as a Power Patron card, so Medius can call it.
Send Medius the Pure to the GY as material.
Send Theorealized Medius to the GY as material.
Link Summon Purification Power Patron to the left Extra Monster Zone using the two non-Link monsters.
Activate effect: Purification Power Patron's summon trigger. Theorealized Medius counts as a Power Patron monster in your GY.
Add Theorealize Overdrive from your Deck to your hand.
Activate Theorealize Overdrive from your hand, targeting Medius the Pure in your GY.
Theorealize Overdrive resolves: Special Summon Medius the Pure. Its own summon effect was already used this turn, so it does nothing this time.
Theorealize Overdrive goes to the GY.
Send Purification Power Patron to the GY as material. It's a Link-2, so it counts as 2 materials.
Send Medius the Pure to the GY as material.
Link Summon Mediclius the Extraordinary Power Patron to the left Extra Monster Zone. From there its arrows point down at your three leftmost Main Monster Zones.
Activate effect: banish Ars Magna the Finite and the Infinite from your hand.
Add Ars Magna the Division and the Union from your Deck to your hand. For the rest of this turn, the original ATK of Mediclius is tripled, from 3000 to 9000.
Activate effect: banish Ars Magna the Division and the Union from your hand.
Special Summon the Finite and the Infinite from banishment, into a zone Mediclius points to. This turn, Mediclius can make up to 3 attacks on monsters.

Activate effect: Mediclius now points to 1 monster, so its 1+ effect is live. During your Main Phase, negate the effects of every face-up monster your opponent controls, and halve their ATK until the end of the turn.

Activate effect: Ars Magna the Finite and the Infinite. You control a Power Patron Link Monster, so target 1 monster on the field and banish it. Spend it on what Mediclius can't handle: a face-down monster, or a Defense Position wall.
Battle Phase: Mediclius attacks up to 3 of your opponent's monsters with 9000 ATK while they sit at half ATK. A single attack into a 2000 ATK monster, now 1000, deals 8000 damage on its own.

combo2.title: Mediclius: Going-First Three-Arrow Board
combo2.description: The same two cards, going first. Every Ars Magna cost is a face-up banish, so Theorealized Medius turns the first one into another card from the Deck. The Purification Power Patron Link Summon calls the banished Corruption and the Purification and Division and the Union back to the field. Mediclius replaces Purification, and Theorealize Past Lull (enabled by Citrinitas, which counts as an Artmage card) fills the last zone it points to. You pass with Mediclius pointing to 3 monsters: unaffected by your opponent's activated effects, with its full-board banish ready on their turn. Starting hand: Medius the Pure + Ars Magna the Finite and the Infinite.

Activate effect: Theorealized Medius. A monster was just banished face-up.
Add Ars Magna the Division and the Union from your Deck to your hand.
Activate effect: banish Ars Magna the Corruption and the Purification from your hand. Theorealized Medius has already used its effect this turn, so this banish adds nothing more.
Add Ars Magna "Citrinitas" from your Deck to your hand.
Activate effect: banish Ars Magna the Division and the Union from your hand.
Special Summon the Finite and the Infinite from banishment, to your leftmost Main Monster Zone.
Send Medius the Pure to the GY as material.
Send Theorealized Medius to the GY as material.
Link Summon Purification Power Patron to the left Extra Monster Zone.
Activate effects in the same chain: a Link Monster was just Special Summoned, so the banished Ars Magna the Corruption and the Purification Special Summons itself.
In the same chain, the banished Ars Magna the Division and the Union Special Summons itself too.
Activate effect: Purification Power Patron's summon trigger, in that same chain. Theorealized Medius counts as a Power Patron monster in your GY.
Add Theorealize Past Lull from your Deck to your hand.
Activate Ars Magna "Citrinitas". It is always treated as an Artmage, DoomZ and Elfnote card.
Send Purification Power Patron to the GY as material. It counts as 2 materials.
Send Ars Magna the Division and the Union to the GY as material.
Link Summon Mediclius the Extraordinary Power Patron to the left Extra Monster Zone. The Finite and the Infinite and the Corruption and the Purification stay in two of the zones Mediclius points to.
Activate Theorealize Past Lull. You control Citrinitas, which counts as an Artmage card, so its condition is met.

Theorealize Past Lull resolves: Special Summon Medius the Pure from your Deck into the last zone Mediclius points to. Your opponent can't respond to the summon, and Medius's summon effect was already used this turn.
Theorealize Past Lull goes to the GY.

End board: Mediclius points to 3 monsters. It is unaffected by your opponent's activated effects, and once during their turn it can banish itself and every card they control. With Citrinitas face-up, the Finite and the Infinite (banish a monster) and the Corruption and the Purification (banish a Spell/Trap) work as Quick Effects. Use them before Mediclius banishes itself, while you still control a Power Patron Link Monster.

combo3.title: Mediclius: Summoned on the Opponent's Turn
combo3.description: The same two cards, but Mediclius waits in the Extra Deck. You pass with Purification Power Patron, Medius the Pure, the Corruption and the Purification and Citrinitas on the field, with the Finite and the Infinite and the Division and the Union banished. In your opponent's Main Phase, Purification's Quick Effect Link Summons Mediclius, and that Link Summon returns both banished Ars Magna monsters into the zones it points to. Mediclius arrives already pointing to 3 monsters, with its full-board banish ready that same turn. Starting hand: Medius the Pure + Ars Magna the Finite and the Infinite.
